At Hosting Nigeria, your privacy and data protection are extremely important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our website, products, and services.

By using our services, you agree to the terms described in this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information to provide you with reliable, secure, and personalized services. The types of information we may collect include:

a. Personal Information

When you sign up or place an order, we may collect:

  • Full Name

  • Email Address

  • Phone Number

  • Billing Address

  • Company/Organization Name (if applicable)

  • Payment Details (handled securely by third-party processors)

b. Technical Information

We may automatically collect non-personal data such as:

  • IP Address

  • Browser Type and Version

  • Device Information

  • Operating System

  • Time Zone and Location Data

  • Website Usage and Access Logs

c. Communication Data

We store messages or communications you send to us through:

  • Email

  • Live Chat

  • Support Tickets

  • Contact Forms

This helps us improve customer service and maintain accurate service history.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information to:

  • Provide and maintain our hosting and domain services

  • Process orders and payments

  • Manage your client account and billing

  • Communicate important updates or notifications

  • Respond to inquiries and provide technical support

  • Improve our website, products, and customer experience

  • Detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized activities

  • Comply with legal obligations

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

3. Data Storage and Security

We take your data protection seriously.
Hosting Nigeria implements advanced administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information from:

  • Unauthorized access

  • Loss or theft

  • Misuse or alteration

Your data is stored securely on servers located in data centers with restricted access and multi-layered protection.

All sensitive information (such as passwords and payment data) is encrypted during transmission using SSL (Secure Socket Layer) technology.

4. Data Retention

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to:

  • Provide ongoing services

  • Fulfill legal or accounting requirements

  • Resolve disputes or enforce agreements

If you terminate your account, your data will be deleted after a reasonable retention period unless required by law to be preserved.

5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience and improve site performance.

Cookies help us:

  • Remember your login sessions

  • Track website usage analytics

  • Personalize content and offers

You can disable cookies in your browser settings; however, doing so may affect some features of our site.

6. Third-Party Services

We may use reputable third-party providers to process specific functions such as:

  • Payment processing (e.g., PayPal, Flutterwave, bank gateways)

  • Domain registration and management

  • Email delivery and customer support

These providers operate under their own privacy policies. We only share the information necessary for them to perform their contracted services securely.

7. Email Communication and Marketing

By signing up with Hosting Nigeria, you consent to receive:

  • Transactional emails (invoices, updates, notifications)

  • Occasional marketing or promotional emails

You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time using the “Unsubscribe” link in our messages.
However, service-related notifications (such as billing reminders or system updates) will still be sent as they are essential to your account management.

8. Your Rights

As our customer, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you

  • Request correction of inaccurate information

  • Request deletion of your personal data (subject to legal and service-related limitations)

  • Withdraw consent for certain data uses

  • Request a copy of your personal data

You can exercise these rights by contacting us through our official support channels.

9. Children’s Privacy

Our services are not intended for children under 18 years of age.
We do not knowingly collect or store information from minors. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal data, please contact us immediately for prompt removal.

10. Data Sharing and Legal Disclosure

We may disclose your information only when:

  • Required by law, regulation, or court order

  • Necessary to protect Hosting Nigeria’s rights or property

  • Required to prevent or investigate fraud, abuse, or security incidents

  • Needed to fulfill essential services through authorized third parties

11. Links to Other Websites

Our website may contain links to third-party sites.
Hosting Nigeria is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external websites. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

12. Policy Updates

Hosting Nigeria reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements.
All updates will be posted on this page with a revised “Last Updated” date. Continued use of our services indicates acceptance of the updated terms.

13. Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

📧 Email: support@hostingnigeria.com
🌐 Website: www.hostingnigeria.com
📞 Phone: +234 916 042 1899
